summary: RETEST of Map clustering (iteration 15) - DOM-marker supercluster approach: PASSED. Clusters render at low zoom with numeric counts (data-testid=map-cluster), individual pins render at high zoom (data-testid=map-property-pin), cluster clicks expand/zoom the map, pin clicks open PropertySheet. Zero '[MapLibre error]' and zero page/JS errors observed throughout.
test_scenarios_verified: Login via form (login-email-input / login-password-input / login-submit-button) and SPA navigation via a[href='/map'] loads [data-testid=map-container] with OSM base map — no MapLibre errors.
Selecting TEST_Territory_f7843e (20 properties) at default fit renders 5 map-cluster badges (labels 2/3/2/2/2) + 9 map-property-pin markers; selected-summary shows '20 properties on map'.
Zooming out (zoom-out control x5) collapses everything into a single cluster labeled '20'.
Clicking the '20' cluster triggers easeTo/getClusterExpansionZoom — map zooms in and the single cluster breaks into 4 separate clusters (expansion behavior confirmed).
Zooming in (zoom-in control x8) removes all clusters (0) and individual property pins render (map-property-pin visible over the tiles).
Clicking a map-property-pin opens PropertySheet ([data-testid=property-sheet], role=dialog) with full property detail (address, beds/baths, coords, owner).
Console captured — 0 '[MapLibre error]' messages, 0 pageerrors, only benign WebGL GPU-stall warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: MapView.jsx renderClusters() correctly registers 'moveend' to reindex on pan/zoom and clearMarkers() cleans DOM markers — no leak observed across zoom/pan cycles.
clusterZoomMax=16 with map maxZoom=19 gives a healthy pin range; consider exposing radius (55) via config if territories need denser clustering.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded TEST_Territory_f7843e (20 properties).
context_for_next_testing_agent: DOM-marker clustering (supercluster main-thread) is now working end-to-end. Selectors: [data-testid=map-cluster] (badges with count text), [data-testid=map-property-pin] (individual). To reproduce: login → click a[href='/map'] (SPA nav, DO NOT hard reload) → wait ~3.5s → select the territory that displays '20 properties' → cluster/pin markers appear over [data-testid=map-container]. Use .maplibregl-ctrl-zoom-in / .maplibregl-ctrl-zoom-out to change zoom.
rca of the issue: Iterations 13/14 failed because MapLibre's geojson WORKER never tiled the 'properties' source in this webpack build, so nothing rendered. Iteration 15 fix bypasses the worker entirely by building a Supercluster index on the main thread and rendering results as maplibregl.Marker HTML DOM elements re-computed on 'moveend'. Verified visually and via querySelector counts.
